description:
**About Us:**
 BW Converting is a strategic alliance of resources and services that bring together several Barry\-Wehmiller companies — Paper Converting Machine Company (PCMC), Winkler \+ Dünnebier (W\+D), STAX Technologies, Hudson\-Sharp, Baldwin Technologies and Northern Engraving and Machine. These industry leaders offer trusted brands and innovative technologies in the design, manufacture, and service of high\-performance converting and packaging machinery for the tissue, nonwovens, hygiene, bag\-converting, mailing, and printing industries.
   

  

 Barry\-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper\-converting industries. By blending people\-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose\-driven growth, Barry\-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.**
 At Barry\-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.
   

  

 What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well\-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.
   

  

 In India, Barry\-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry\-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.
   

  

**Our culture is built on:**
* Ownership – Drive features end\-to\-end, from design to deployment.
* Flexibility – A friendly, results\-oriented environment that respects your time.
* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.
* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.


**Career Development and Global Exposure**
 At Barry\-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world\-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting\-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.
   

  

 If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high\-impact, future\-focused environment—where long\-term stability meets start\-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**Job description:**
 The Project Manager would lead and oversee strategic projects in India. This role requires a highly organised individual with administrative and project management skills. The successful candidate will ensure that projects meet customer requirements for high level of administrative compliance. The Project Manager will work closely with local and international colleagues to ensure all customer requirements are aligned for successful execution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, and deliverables that align with all customer requirements
* Monitor project progress, proactively assess project status and mitigate risks
* Hold regular internal review meetings to ensure we are meeting customer expectations
* Hold regular customer and customer nominated consultant meetings to advise on project progress
* Follow internal processes and maintain accurate project records, through risk registers, issue logs, decision logs, and action trackers
* Act as the local primary point of contact for projects
* Build and maintain effective relationships with customers and there nominated consultants
* Coordinate communications between local and international teams
* Manage and upload customer documentation to customer portal, ensuring revision integrity is being upheld
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and reporting requirements


**Required Skills**
* Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities
* Strong administrative and documentation skills
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
* Relationship\-building capabilities
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Microsoft Project, SharePoint, and collaboration platforms such as Microsoft Teams
* Flexible to travel within India
* Fluent in English
* Needs to be a local resident to the office


**Key Competencies**
* Planning and execution
* Administrative excellence
* Stakeholder engagement
* Communication
* Risk management
* Time management
* Attention to detail
* Adaptability
* Professionalism and integrity


**Qualification \& Experience**
* Degree in Engineering, Project Management or Business Administration, or a related field
* 5\+ years of project co\-ordination experience
* Experience managing projects in India
* Experience providing extensive administrative and operational project support
* Project Management certification would be preferred


**Travel:**
* May need to travel up to10% each year based on requirements.


 We believe our culture differentiates us from other firms. To know more about us and our people\-centric culture, you may like to watch a 20 Minute video from Late Mr. Robert Chapman \- Chairman of Barry\-Wehmiller.  Barry\-Wehmiller is a place where you can bring your best self to life through the work that you do — no matter the path you choose.

description:
**About Company:** 




 Group Bayport is a rapidly growing global e\-Commerce, B2B2C, B2B and B2C organization and an industry leader in print technology, operates in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, UK, and India through its family of brands – Banner Buzz, Covers \& All, Vivyx Printing, Circle One, Giant Media, Neon Earth, Optamark and North cape. From full suites of trade show and small business marketing solutions to sophisticated outdoor living covers, signages and shades to eclectic personal accents and home decor, we help our customers, clients, and partners to make a personalized statement through ,customization.
 



  





 While our advanced technology and customer focus are certainly our salient attributes, our true strength comes from our team of 1800\+ people. We are seeking exceptional talent across the board to join us in our exciting growth journey.
 



  





 For more about Group Bayport, please visit
 



**Website:** 
 https://groupbayport.com/about\-us/
 



**LinkedIn:** 
 https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/mycompany/
 



  





**Designation: Manager \- Production Planning** 




**Location: Gandhinagar** 




  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced Manager in Production Planning to oversee and optimize our production processes. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in production planning and control, ensuring efficient utilization of resources and timely delivery of products.
 



  





  





**Roles and Responsibilities:** 



* Should handle and lead tasks pertaining to production planning and control.
* Implementation of internal plans to ensure timely accomplishment of production targets and manufacturing.
* Preparing and maintaining entire production\-related reports and timely submission.
* Able to implement effective techniques to bring efficiency in operation to improve the quality of the product.
* Undertaking resource planning for optimizing effective utilization.
* Handle various processes/applications and recommend process modification.
* Must handle Interdepartmental communication for smoother run
* Day to day communication with design, B2B,Production team for daily issues and SBD confirmation
* To plan B2B and FBA order execution and tracking
* For daily or monthly shipping analysis as per the orders shipped
* Tracker and Major report preparation for inhouse and Local vendor products
* Day to day communication with design team in case of file issues



  





  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field
* 8\-10 years of experience in production planning and control
* Proven track record of improving production efficiency
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent communication and leadership abilities



  





**Educational Certifications:** 



* Graduate or postgraduate
